{{Infobox religious building| religious_affiliation = [[Shinto]] | religious_affiliation = [[Shinto]] |image = [[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|250px|right]] | name = Yasaka Shrine (八坂神社) | location = [[:en:Fukuoka Prefecture|Fukuoka]], [[:en:Kitakyushu|Kitakyushu]], [[:en:Kokurakita Ward|Kokurakita Ward]], {{ill|Jōnai|ja|城内 (北九州市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jōnai|qq=|1=Jōnai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11425982}} | coordinates = {{Coord|33|53|07.68|N|130|52|25.39|E|region:JP-40_type:landmark|display=inline,title|name=Yasaka Shrine}} | Deities = {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}} (formerly [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]]) | type = [[Prefectural Shrine|Ken-sha]] (as of May 15, Meiji 6) | Established = [[:en:Hosokawa Tadaoki|Hosokawa Tadaoki]], [[Genna (era)|Genna]] 3 (1617) | Main Hall = Nagare-zukuri | Festival = [[Kokura Gion Daiko]] (third Saturday/Sunday in July) }}
'''Yasaka Shrine''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, やさかじんじゃ) refers to [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrines]] named "Yasaka." It is sometimes written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}, which is covered in another article.
These shrines are dedicated to {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}}, the deity of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]]. Before the {{ill|Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|ja|神仏分離令|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神仏分離|1=shinbutsu bunri|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1970535}}, Susanoo-no-Mikoto was identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]].
Other names based on Gion faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|lt=Gion Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, {{ill|Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|広峯神社 (曖昧さ回避)|lt=Hiromine Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|lt=Tennō Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrines]], {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|lt=Yakumo Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|qq=|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrines]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|須佐神社|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|lt=Susa Shrine|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|1=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11664499}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine (disambiguation)]].
Notably, some exceptions include Yasaka shrines that enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]].
== Main Shrine == [[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Kyoto's [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]], one of the head shrines]] * '''[[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]]''' ({{ill|Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|ja|京都市東山区|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}) – Formerly {{ill|Kanjin'in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin'in Gion-sha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} under [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai Buddhism]] and [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]] until the Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order. Claimed as the main shrine of Susanoo-no-Mikoto nationwide.
* ''' {{ill|Eki Shrine|ja|疫神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eki Shrine|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}}''' – Enshrines {{ill|Somin Shōrai|ja|蘇民将来命|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Somin Shōrai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. '''Yasaka Shrine''' or '''Yasaka Jinja''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, Yasaka Jinja) refers to Shinto shrines that include "Yasaka" in their name. Some may also be written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}.
These shrines are part of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]], venerating {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}} (formerly identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]] before the [[:en:Shinbutsu bunri|Shinbutsu Bunri]] decree).
Other shrines based on Gion Faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, [[:en:Hiromine Shrine|Hiromine Shrine]], {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Tsushima Faith|ja|津島信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsushima Faith|qq=}}</ref>, {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|qq=|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrine]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine|ja|須佐神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine|qq=}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Faith|ja|氷川信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hikawa Faith|qq=}}</ref>, among others. Their usage varies by historical period and records.
However, there are exceptions where Yasaka Shrines enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]] instead.
The [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine (Kyoto)]] in Higashiyama, Kyoto, claims to be the head shrine of all shrines dedicated to Susanoo-no-Mikoto. Before the Shinbutsu Bunri decree, it was known as {{ill|Kanjin-in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin-in Gion-sha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} of the [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai sect]], affiliated with [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]].

{{Infobox religious building| religious_affiliation = [[Shinto]] | religious_affiliation = [[Shinto]] |image = [[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|250px|right]] | name = Yasaka Shrine (八坂神社) | location = [[:en:Fukuoka Prefecture|Fukuoka]], [[:en:Kitakyushu|Kitakyushu]], [[:en:Kokurakita Ward|Kokurakita Ward]], {{ill|Jōnai|ja|城内 (北九州市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jōnai|qq=|1=Jōnai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11425982}} | coordinates = {{Coord|33|53|07.68|N|130|52|25.39|E|region:JP-40_type:landmark|display=inline,title|name=Yasaka Shrine}} | Deities = {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}} (formerly [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]]) | type = [[Prefectural Shrine|Ken-sha]] (as of May 15, Meiji 6) | Established = [[:en:Hosokawa Tadaoki|Hosokawa Tadaoki]], [[Genna (era)|Genna]] 3 (1617) | Main Hall = Nagare-zukuri | Festival = [[Kokura Gion Daiko]] (third Saturday/Sunday in July) }}
'''Yasaka Shrine''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, やさかじんじゃ) refers to [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrines]] named "Yasaka." It is sometimes written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}, which is covered in another article.
These shrines are dedicated to {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}}, the deity of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]]. Before the {{ill|Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|ja|神仏分離令|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神仏分離|1=shinbutsu bunri|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1970535}}, Susanoo-no-Mikoto was identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]].
Other names based on Gion faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|lt=Gion Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, {{ill|Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|広峯神社 (曖昧さ回避)|lt=Hiromine Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|lt=Tennō Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrines]], {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|lt=Yakumo Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|qq=|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrines]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|須佐神社|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|lt=Susa Shrine|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|1=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11664499}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine (disambiguation)]].
Notably, some exceptions include Yasaka shrines that enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]].
== Main Shrine == [[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Kyoto's [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]], one of the head shrines]] * '''[[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]]''' ({{ill|Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|ja|京都市東山区|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}) – Formerly {{ill|Kanjin'in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin'in Gion-sha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} under [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai Buddhism]] and [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]] until the Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order. Claimed as the main shrine of Susanoo-no-Mikoto nationwide.
* ''' {{ill|Eki Shrine|ja|疫神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eki Shrine|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}}''' – Enshrines {{ill|Somin Shōrai|ja|蘇民将来命|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Somin Shōrai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. '''Yasaka Shrine''' or '''Yasaka Jinja''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, Yasaka Jinja) refers to Shinto shrines that include "Yasaka" in their name. Some may also be written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}.
These shrines are part of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]], venerating {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}} (formerly identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]] before the [[:en:Shinbutsu bunri|Shinbutsu Bunri]] decree).
Other shrines based on Gion Faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, [[:en:Hiromine Shrine|Hiromine Shrine]], {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Tsushima Faith|ja|津島信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsushima Faith|qq=}}</ref>, {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|qq=|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrine]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine|ja|須佐神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine|qq=}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Faith|ja|氷川信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hikawa Faith|qq=}}</ref>, among others. Their usage varies by historical period and records.
However, there are exceptions where Yasaka Shrines enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]] instead.
The [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine (Kyoto)]] in Higashiyama, Kyoto, claims to be the head shrine of all shrines dedicated to Susanoo-no-Mikoto. Before the Shinbutsu Bunri decree, it was known as {{ill|Kanjin-in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin-in Gion-sha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} of the [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai sect]], affiliated with [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]].
[[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|thumb|250px|right|[[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine (Kyoto)]] (One of the Head Shrines)]]

One of nine Yasaka Shrines in the city, known as "Tenno-sama of Yori-se" and host of the Tenno Festival. * {{ill|Yasaka Shrine (Tako, Chiba)|en|八坂神社 (多古町)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine (Tako, Chiba)|qq=}} – Located in Tako, Tako Town, Katori District, Chiba Prefecture; known for the Tako Gion Festival.
This continues with more shrines in Tokyo, Kanagawa, Chubu, Kinki, Chugoku-Shikoku, and Kyushu regions, following the same format.

{{Infobox religious building| religious_affiliation = [[Shinto]] | religious_affiliation = [[Shinto]] |image = [[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|250px|right]] | name = Yasaka Shrine (八坂神社) | location = [[:en:Fukuoka Prefecture|Fukuoka]], [[:en:Kitakyushu|Kitakyushu]], [[:en:Kokurakita Ward|Kokurakita Ward]], {{ill|Jōnai|ja|城内 (北九州市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jōnai|qq=|1=Jōnai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11425982}} | coordinates = {{Coord|33|53|07.68|N|130|52|25.39|E|region:JP-40_type:landmark|display=inline,title|name=Yasaka Shrine}} | Deities = {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}} (formerly [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]]) | type = [[Prefectural Shrine|Ken-sha]] (as of May 15, Meiji 6) | Established = [[:en:Hosokawa Tadaoki|Hosokawa Tadaoki]], [[Genna (era)|Genna]] 3 (1617) | Main Hall = Nagare-zukuri | Festival = [[Kokura Gion Daiko]] (third Saturday/Sunday in July) }}
'''Yasaka Shrine''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, やさかじんじゃ) refers to [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrines]] named "Yasaka." It is sometimes written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}, which is covered in another article.
These shrines are dedicated to {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}}, the deity of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]]. Before the {{ill|Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|ja|神仏分離令|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神仏分離|1=shinbutsu bunri|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1970535}}, Susanoo-no-Mikoto was identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]].
Other names based on Gion faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|lt=Gion Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, {{ill|Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|広峯神社 (曖昧さ回避)|lt=Hiromine Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|lt=Tennō Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrines]], {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|lt=Yakumo Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|qq=|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrines]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|須佐神社|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|lt=Susa Shrine|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|1=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11664499}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine (disambiguation)]].
Notably, some exceptions include Yasaka shrines that enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]].
== Main Shrine == [[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Kyoto's [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]], one of the head shrines]] * '''[[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]]''' ({{ill|Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|ja|京都市東山区|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}) – Formerly {{ill|Kanjin'in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin'in Gion-sha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} under [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai Buddhism]] and [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]] until the Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order. Claimed as the main shrine of Susanoo-no-Mikoto nationwide.
* ''' {{ill|Eki Shrine|ja|疫神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eki Shrine|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}}''' – Enshrines {{ill|Somin Shōrai|ja|蘇民将来命|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Somin Shōrai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. '''Yasaka Shrine''' or '''Yasaka Jinja''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, Yasaka Jinja) refers to Shinto shrines that include "Yasaka" in their name. Some may also be written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}.
These shrines are part of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]], venerating {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}} (formerly identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]] before the [[:en:Shinbutsu bunri|Shinbutsu Bunri]] decree).
Other shrines based on Gion Faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, [[:en:Hiromine Shrine|Hiromine Shrine]], {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Tsushima Faith|ja|津島信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsushima Faith|qq=}}</ref>, {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|qq=|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrine]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine|ja|須佐神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine|qq=}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Faith|ja|氷川信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hikawa Faith|qq=}}</ref>, among others. Their usage varies by historical period and records.
However, there are exceptions where Yasaka Shrines enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]] instead.
The [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine (Kyoto)]] in Higashiyama, Kyoto, claims to be the head shrine of all shrines dedicated to Susanoo-no-Mikoto. Before the Shinbutsu Bunri decree, it was known as {{ill|Kanjin-in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin-in Gion-sha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} of the [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai sect]], affiliated with [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]].
[[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|thumb|250px|right|[[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine (Kyoto)]] (One of the Head Shrines)]]

'''Yasaka Shrine''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, やさかじんじゃ) refers to [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrines]] named "Yasaka." It is sometimes written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}, which is covered in another article.
These shrines are dedicated to {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}}, the deity of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]]. Before the {{ill|Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|ja|神仏分離令|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神仏分離|1=shinbutsu bunri|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1970535}}, Susanoo-no-Mikoto was identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]].
Other names based on Gion faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|lt=Gion Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, {{ill|Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|広峯神社 (曖昧さ回避)|lt=Hiromine Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|lt=Tennō Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrines]], {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|lt=Yakumo Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|qq=|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrines]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|須佐神社|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|lt=Susa Shrine|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|1=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11664499}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine (disambiguation)]].
Notably, some exceptions include Yasaka shrines that enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]].
== Main Shrine == [[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Kyoto's [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]], one of the head shrines]] * '''[[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]]''' ({{ill|Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|ja|京都市東山区|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}) – Formerly {{ill|Kanjin'in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin'in Gion-sha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} under [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai Buddhism]] and [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]] until the Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order. Claimed as the main shrine of Susanoo-no-Mikoto nationwide.
* ''' {{ill|Eki Shrine|ja|疫神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eki Shrine|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}}''' – Enshrines {{ill|Somin Shōrai|ja|蘇民将来命|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Somin Shōrai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. '''Yasaka Shrine''' or '''Yasaka Jinja''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, Yasaka Jinja) refers to Shinto shrines that include "Yasaka" in their name. Some may also be written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}.
These shrines are part of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]], venerating {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}} (formerly identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]] before the [[:en:Shinbutsu bunri|Shinbutsu Bunri]] decree).
Other shrines based on Gion Faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, [[:en:Hiromine Shrine|Hiromine Shrine]], {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Tsushima Faith|ja|津島信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsushima Faith|qq=}}</ref>, {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|qq=|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrine]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine|ja|須佐神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine|qq=}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Faith|ja|氷川信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hikawa Faith|qq=}}</ref>, among others. Their usage varies by historical period and records.
However, there are exceptions where Yasaka Shrines enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]] instead.
The [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine (Kyoto)]] in Higashiyama, Kyoto, claims to be the head shrine of all shrines dedicated to Susanoo-no-Mikoto. Before the Shinbutsu Bunri decree, it was known as {{ill|Kanjin-in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin-in Gion-sha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} of the [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai sect]], affiliated with [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]].

{{Infobox religious building| religious_affiliation = [[Shinto]] | religious_affiliation = [[Shinto]] |image = [[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|250px|right]] | name = Yasaka Shrine (八坂神社) | location = [[:en:Fukuoka Prefecture|Fukuoka]], [[:en:Kitakyushu|Kitakyushu]], [[:en:Kokurakita Ward|Kokurakita Ward]], {{ill|Jōnai|ja|城内 (北九州市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jōnai|qq=|1=Jōnai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11425982}} | coordinates = {{Coord|33|53|07.68|N|130|52|25.39|E|region:JP-40_type:landmark|display=inline,title|name=Yasaka Shrine}} | Deities = {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}} (formerly [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]]) | type = [[Prefectural Shrine|Ken-sha]] (as of May 15, Meiji 6) | Established = [[:en:Hosokawa Tadaoki|Hosokawa Tadaoki]], [[Genna (era)|Genna]] 3 (1617) | Main Hall = Nagare-zukuri | Festival = [[Kokura Gion Daiko]] (third Saturday/Sunday in July) }}
'''Yasaka Shrine''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, やさかじんじゃ) refers to [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrines]] named "Yasaka." It is sometimes written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}, which is covered in another article.
These shrines are dedicated to {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}}, the deity of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]]. Before the {{ill|Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|ja|神仏分離令|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神仏分離|1=shinbutsu bunri|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1970535}}, Susanoo-no-Mikoto was identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]].
Other names based on Gion faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|lt=Gion Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, {{ill|Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|広峯神社 (曖昧さ回避)|lt=Hiromine Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|lt=Tennō Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrines]], {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|lt=Yakumo Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|qq=|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrines]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|須佐神社|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|lt=Susa Shrine|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|1=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11664499}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine (disambiguation)]].
Notably, some exceptions include Yasaka shrines that enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]].
== Main Shrine == [[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Kyoto's [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]], one of the head shrines]] * '''[[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]]''' ({{ill|Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|ja|京都市東山区|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}) – Formerly {{ill|Kanjin'in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin'in Gion-sha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} under [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai Buddhism]] and [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]] until the Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order. Claimed as the main shrine of Susanoo-no-Mikoto nationwide.
* ''' {{ill|Eki Shrine|ja|疫神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eki Shrine|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}}''' – Enshrines {{ill|Somin Shōrai|ja|蘇民将来命|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Somin Shōrai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. '''Yasaka Shrine''' or '''Yasaka Jinja''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, Yasaka Jinja) refers to Shinto shrines that include "Yasaka" in their name. Some may also be written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}.
These shrines are part of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]], venerating {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}} (formerly identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]] before the [[:en:Shinbutsu bunri|Shinbutsu Bunri]] decree).
Other shrines based on Gion Faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, [[:en:Hiromine Shrine|Hiromine Shrine]], {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Tsushima Faith|ja|津島信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsushima Faith|qq=}}</ref>, {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|qq=|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrine]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine|ja|須佐神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine|qq=}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Faith|ja|氷川信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hikawa Faith|qq=}}</ref>, among others. Their usage varies by historical period and records.
However, there are exceptions where Yasaka Shrines enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]] instead.
The [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine (Kyoto)]] in Higashiyama, Kyoto, claims to be the head shrine of all shrines dedicated to Susanoo-no-Mikoto. Before the Shinbutsu Bunri decree, it was known as {{ill|Kanjin-in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin-in Gion-sha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} of the [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai sect]], affiliated with [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]].

{{Infobox religious building| religious_affiliation = [[Shinto]] | religious_affiliation = [[Shinto]] |image = [[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|250px|right]] | name = Yasaka Shrine (八坂神社) | location = [[:en:Fukuoka Prefecture|Fukuoka]], [[:en:Kitakyushu|Kitakyushu]], [[:en:Kokurakita Ward|Kokurakita Ward]], {{ill|Jōnai|ja|城内 (北九州市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jōnai|qq=|1=Jōnai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11425982}} | coordinates = {{Coord|33|53|07.68|N|130|52|25.39|E|region:JP-40_type:landmark|display=inline,title|name=Yasaka Shrine}} | Deities = {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}} (formerly [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]]) | type = [[Prefectural Shrine|Ken-sha]] (as of May 15, Meiji 6) | Established = [[:en:Hosokawa Tadaoki|Hosokawa Tadaoki]], [[Genna (era)|Genna]] 3 (1617) | Main Hall = Nagare-zukuri | Festival = [[Kokura Gion Daiko]] (third Saturday/Sunday in July) }}
'''Yasaka Shrine''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, やさかじんじゃ) refers to [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrines]] named "Yasaka." It is sometimes written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}, which is covered in another article.
These shrines are dedicated to {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}}, the deity of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]]. Before the {{ill|Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|ja|神仏分離令|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神仏分離|1=shinbutsu bunri|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1970535}}, Susanoo-no-Mikoto was identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]].
Other names based on Gion faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|lt=Gion Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, {{ill|Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|広峯神社 (曖昧さ回避)|lt=Hiromine Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|lt=Tennō Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrines]], {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|lt=Yakumo Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|qq=|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrines]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|須佐神社|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|lt=Susa Shrine|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|1=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11664499}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine (disambiguation)]].
Notably, some exceptions include Yasaka shrines that enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]].
== Main Shrine == [[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Kyoto's [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]], one of the head shrines]] * '''[[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]]''' ({{ill|Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|ja|京都市東山区|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}) – Formerly {{ill|Kanjin'in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin'in Gion-sha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} under [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai Buddhism]] and [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]] until the Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order. Claimed as the main shrine of Susanoo-no-Mikoto nationwide.
* ''' {{ill|Eki Shrine|ja|疫神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eki Shrine|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}}''' – Enshrines {{ill|Somin Shōrai|ja|蘇民将来命|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Somin Shōrai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. '''Yasaka Shrine''' or '''Yasaka Jinja''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, Yasaka Jinja) refers to Shinto shrines that include "Yasaka" in their name. Some may also be written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}.
These shrines are part of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]], venerating {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}} (formerly identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]] before the [[:en:Shinbutsu bunri|Shinbutsu Bunri]] decree).
Other shrines based on Gion Faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, [[:en:Hiromine Shrine|Hiromine Shrine]], {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Tsushima Faith|ja|津島信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsushima Faith|qq=}}</ref>, {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|qq=|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrine]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine|ja|須佐神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine|qq=}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Faith|ja|氷川信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hikawa Faith|qq=}}</ref>, among others. Their usage varies by historical period and records.
However, there are exceptions where Yasaka Shrines enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]] instead.
The [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine (Kyoto)]] in Higashiyama, Kyoto, claims to be the head shrine of all shrines dedicated to Susanoo-no-Mikoto. Before the Shinbutsu Bunri decree, it was known as {{ill|Kanjin-in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin-in Gion-sha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} of the [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai sect]], affiliated with [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]].
[[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|thumb|250px|right|[[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine (Kyoto)]] (One of the Head Shrines)]]

{{Infobox religious building| religious_affiliation = [[Shinto]] | religious_affiliation = [[Shinto]] |image = [[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|250px|right]] | name = Yasaka Shrine (八坂神社) | location = [[:en:Fukuoka Prefecture|Fukuoka]], [[:en:Kitakyushu|Kitakyushu]], [[:en:Kokurakita Ward|Kokurakita Ward]], {{ill|Jōnai|ja|城内 (北九州市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jōnai|qq=|1=Jōnai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11425982}} | coordinates = {{Coord|33|53|07.68|N|130|52|25.39|E|region:JP-40_type:landmark|display=inline,title|name=Yasaka Shrine}} | Deities = {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}} (formerly [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]]) | type = [[Prefectural Shrine|Ken-sha]] (as of May 15, Meiji 6) | Established = [[:en:Hosokawa Tadaoki|Hosokawa Tadaoki]], [[Genna (era)|Genna]] 3 (1617) | Main Hall = Nagare-zukuri | Festival = [[Kokura Gion Daiko]] (third Saturday/Sunday in July) }}
'''Yasaka Shrine''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, やさかじんじゃ) refers to [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrines]] named "Yasaka." It is sometimes written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}, which is covered in another article.
These shrines are dedicated to {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}}, the deity of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]]. Before the {{ill|Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|ja|神仏分離令|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神仏分離|1=shinbutsu bunri|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1970535}}, Susanoo-no-Mikoto was identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]].
Other names based on Gion faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|lt=Gion Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, {{ill|Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|広峯神社 (曖昧さ回避)|lt=Hiromine Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|lt=Tennō Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrines]], {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|lt=Yakumo Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|qq=|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrines]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|須佐神社|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|lt=Susa Shrine|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|1=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11664499}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine (disambiguation)]].
Notably, some exceptions include Yasaka shrines that enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]].
== Main Shrine == [[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Kyoto's [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]], one of the head shrines]] * '''[[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]]''' ({{ill|Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|ja|京都市東山区|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}) – Formerly {{ill|Kanjin'in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin'in Gion-sha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} under [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai Buddhism]] and [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]] until the Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order. Claimed as the main shrine of Susanoo-no-Mikoto nationwide.
* ''' {{ill|Eki Shrine|ja|疫神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eki Shrine|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}}''' – Enshrines {{ill|Somin Shōrai|ja|蘇民将来命|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Somin Shōrai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. '''Yasaka Shrine''' or '''Yasaka Jinja''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, Yasaka Jinja) refers to Shinto shrines that include "Yasaka" in their name. Some may also be written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}.
These shrines are part of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]], venerating {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}} (formerly identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]] before the [[:en:Shinbutsu bunri|Shinbutsu Bunri]] decree).
Other shrines based on Gion Faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, [[:en:Hiromine Shrine|Hiromine Shrine]], {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Tsushima Faith|ja|津島信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsushima Faith|qq=}}</ref>, {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|qq=|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrine]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine|ja|須佐神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine|qq=}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Faith|ja|氷川信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hikawa Faith|qq=}}</ref>, among others. Their usage varies by historical period and records.
However, there are exceptions where Yasaka Shrines enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]] instead.
The [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine (Kyoto)]] in Higashiyama, Kyoto, claims to be the head shrine of all shrines dedicated to Susanoo-no-Mikoto. Before the Shinbutsu Bunri decree, it was known as {{ill|Kanjin-in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin-in Gion-sha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} of the [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai sect]], affiliated with [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]].

{{Infobox religious building| religious_affiliation = [[Shinto]] | religious_affiliation = [[Shinto]] |image = [[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|250px|right]] | name = Yasaka Shrine (八坂神社) | location = [[:en:Fukuoka Prefecture|Fukuoka]], [[:en:Kitakyushu|Kitakyushu]], [[:en:Kokurakita Ward|Kokurakita Ward]], {{ill|Jōnai|ja|城内 (北九州市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jōnai|qq=|1=Jōnai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11425982}} | coordinates = {{Coord|33|53|07.68|N|130|52|25.39|E|region:JP-40_type:landmark|display=inline,title|name=Yasaka Shrine}} | Deities = {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}} (formerly [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]]) | type = [[Prefectural Shrine|Ken-sha]] (as of May 15, Meiji 6) | Established = [[:en:Hosokawa Tadaoki|Hosokawa Tadaoki]], [[Genna (era)|Genna]] 3 (1617) | Main Hall = Nagare-zukuri | Festival = [[Kokura Gion Daiko]] (third Saturday/Sunday in July) }}
'''Yasaka Shrine''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, やさかじんじゃ) refers to [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrines]] named "Yasaka." It is sometimes written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}, which is covered in another article.
These shrines are dedicated to {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}}, the deity of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]]. Before the {{ill|Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|ja|神仏分離令|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神仏分離|1=shinbutsu bunri|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1970535}}, Susanoo-no-Mikoto was identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]].
Other names based on Gion faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|lt=Gion Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, {{ill|Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|広峯神社 (曖昧さ回避)|lt=Hiromine Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|lt=Tennō Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrines]], {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|lt=Yakumo Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|qq=|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrines]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|須佐神社|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|lt=Susa Shrine|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|1=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11664499}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine (disambiguation)]].
Notably, some exceptions include Yasaka shrines that enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]].
== Main Shrine == [[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Kyoto's [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]], one of the head shrines]] * '''[[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]]''' ({{ill|Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|ja|京都市東山区|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}) – Formerly {{ill|Kanjin'in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin'in Gion-sha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} under [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai Buddhism]] and [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]] until the Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order. Claimed as the main shrine of Susanoo-no-Mikoto nationwide.
* ''' {{ill|Eki Shrine|ja|疫神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eki Shrine|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}}''' – Enshrines {{ill|Somin Shōrai|ja|蘇民将来命|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Somin Shōrai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. '''Yasaka Shrine''' or '''Yasaka Jinja''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, Yasaka Jinja) refers to Shinto shrines that include "Yasaka" in their name. Some may also be written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}.
These shrines are part of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]], venerating {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}} (formerly identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]] before the [[:en:Shinbutsu bunri|Shinbutsu Bunri]] decree).
Other shrines based on Gion Faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, [[:en:Hiromine Shrine|Hiromine Shrine]], {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Tsushima Faith|ja|津島信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsushima Faith|qq=}}</ref>, {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|qq=|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrine]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine|ja|須佐神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine|qq=}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Faith|ja|氷川信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hikawa Faith|qq=}}</ref>, among others. Their usage varies by historical period and records.
However, there are exceptions where Yasaka Shrines enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]] instead.
The [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine (Kyoto)]] in Higashiyama, Kyoto, claims to be the head shrine of all shrines dedicated to Susanoo-no-Mikoto. Before the Shinbutsu Bunri decree, it was known as {{ill|Kanjin-in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin-in Gion-sha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} of the [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai sect]], affiliated with [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]].
[[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|thumb|250px|right|[[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine (Kyoto)]] (One of the Head Shrines)]]

{{Infobox religious building| religious_affiliation = [[Shinto]] | religious_affiliation = [[Shinto]] |image = [[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|250px|right]] | name = Yasaka Shrine (八坂神社) | location = [[:en:Fukuoka Prefecture|Fukuoka]], [[:en:Kitakyushu|Kitakyushu]], [[:en:Kokurakita Ward|Kokurakita Ward]], {{ill|Jōnai|ja|城内 (北九州市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jōnai|qq=|1=Jōnai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11425982}} | coordinates = {{Coord|33|53|07.68|N|130|52|25.39|E|region:JP-40_type:landmark|display=inline,title|name=Yasaka Shrine}} | Deities = {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}} (formerly [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]]) | type = [[Prefectural Shrine|Ken-sha]] (as of May 15, Meiji 6) | Established = [[:en:Hosokawa Tadaoki|Hosokawa Tadaoki]], [[Genna (era)|Genna]] 3 (1617) | Main Hall = Nagare-zukuri | Festival = [[Kokura Gion Daiko]] (third Saturday/Sunday in July) }}
'''Yasaka Shrine''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, やさかじんじゃ) refers to [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrines]] named "Yasaka." It is sometimes written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}, which is covered in another article.
These shrines are dedicated to {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}}, the deity of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]]. Before the {{ill|Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|ja|神仏分離令|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神仏分離|1=shinbutsu bunri|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1970535}}, Susanoo-no-Mikoto was identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]].
Other names based on Gion faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|lt=Gion Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, {{ill|Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|広峯神社 (曖昧さ回避)|lt=Hiromine Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|lt=Tennō Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrines]], {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|lt=Yakumo Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|qq=|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrines]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|須佐神社|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|lt=Susa Shrine|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|1=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11664499}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine (disambiguation)]].
Notably, some exceptions include Yasaka shrines that enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]].
== Main Shrine == [[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Kyoto's [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]], one of the head shrines]] * '''[[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]]''' ({{ill|Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|ja|京都市東山区|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}) – Formerly {{ill|Kanjin'in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin'in Gion-sha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} under [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai Buddhism]] and [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]] until the Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order. Claimed as the main shrine of Susanoo-no-Mikoto nationwide.
* ''' {{ill|Eki Shrine|ja|疫神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eki Shrine|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}}''' – Enshrines {{ill|Somin Shōrai|ja|蘇民将来命|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Somin Shōrai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. '''Yasaka Shrine''' or '''Yasaka Jinja''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, Yasaka Jinja) refers to Shinto shrines that include "Yasaka" in their name. Some may also be written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}.
These shrines are part of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]], venerating {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}} (formerly identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]] before the [[:en:Shinbutsu bunri|Shinbutsu Bunri]] decree).
Other shrines based on Gion Faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, [[:en:Hiromine Shrine|Hiromine Shrine]], {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Tsushima Faith|ja|津島信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsushima Faith|qq=}}</ref>, {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|qq=|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrine]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine|ja|須佐神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine|qq=}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Faith|ja|氷川信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hikawa Faith|qq=}}</ref>, among others. Their usage varies by historical period and records.
However, there are exceptions where Yasaka Shrines enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]] instead.
The [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine (Kyoto)]] in Higashiyama, Kyoto, claims to be the head shrine of all shrines dedicated to Susanoo-no-Mikoto. Before the Shinbutsu Bunri decree, it was known as {{ill|Kanjin-in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin-in Gion-sha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} of the [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai sect]], affiliated with [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]].

'''Yasaka Shrine''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, やさかじんじゃ) refers to [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrines]] named "Yasaka." It is sometimes written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}, which is covered in another article.
These shrines are dedicated to {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}}, the deity of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]]. Before the {{ill|Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|ja|神仏分離令|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神仏分離|1=shinbutsu bunri|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1970535}}, Susanoo-no-Mikoto was identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]].
Other names based on Gion faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|lt=Gion Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, {{ill|Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|広峯神社 (曖昧さ回避)|lt=Hiromine Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|lt=Tennō Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrines]], {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|lt=Yakumo Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|qq=|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrines]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|須佐神社|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|lt=Susa Shrine|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|1=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11664499}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine (disambiguation)]].
Notably, some exceptions include Yasaka shrines that enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]].
== Main Shrine == [[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Kyoto's [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]], one of the head shrines]] * '''[[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]]''' ({{ill|Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|ja|京都市東山区|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}) – Formerly {{ill|Kanjin'in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin'in Gion-sha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} under [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai Buddhism]] and [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]] until the Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order. Claimed as the main shrine of Susanoo-no-Mikoto nationwide.
* ''' {{ill|Eki Shrine|ja|疫神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eki Shrine|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}}''' – Enshrines {{ill|Somin Shōrai|ja|蘇民将来命|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Somin Shōrai|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. '''Yasaka Shrine''' or '''Yasaka Jinja''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, Yasaka Jinja) refers to Shinto shrines that include "Yasaka" in their name. Some may also be written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}.
These shrines are part of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]], venerating {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}} (formerly identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]] before the [[:en:Shinbutsu bunri|Shinbutsu Bunri]] decree).
Other shrines based on Gion Faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, [[:en:Hiromine Shrine|Hiromine Shrine]], {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Tsushima Faith|ja|津島信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsushima Faith|qq=}}</ref>, {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|qq=|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrine]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine|ja|須佐神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine|qq=}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Faith|ja|氷川信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hikawa Faith|qq=}}</ref>, among others. Their usage varies by historical period and records.
However, there are exceptions where Yasaka Shrines enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]] instead.
The [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine (Kyoto)]] in Higashiyama, Kyoto, claims to be the head shrine of all shrines dedicated to Susanoo-no-Mikoto. Before the Shinbutsu Bunri decree, it was known as {{ill|Kanjin-in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin-in Gion-sha|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} of the [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai sect]], affiliated with [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]].

{{Infobox religious building| religious_affiliation = [[Shinto]] | religious_affiliation = [[Shinto]] |image = [[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|250px|right]] | name = Yasaka Shrine (八坂神社) | location = [[:en:Fukuoka Prefecture|Fukuoka]], [[:en:Kitakyushu|Kitakyushu]], [[:en:Kokurakita Ward|Kokurakita Ward]], {{ill|Jōnai|ja|城内 (北九州市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jōnai|1=Jōnai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11425982}} | coordinates = {{Coord|33|53|07.68|N|130|52|25.39|E|region:JP-40_type:landmark|display=inline,title|name=Yasaka Shrine}} | Deities = {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}} (formerly [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]]) | type = [[Prefectural Shrine|Ken-sha]] (as of May 15, Meiji 6) | Established = [[:en:Hosokawa Tadaoki|Hosokawa Tadaoki]], [[Genna (era)|Genna]] 3 (1617) | Main Hall = Nagare-zukuri | Festival = [[Kokura Gion Daiko]] (third Saturday/Sunday in July) }}
'''Yasaka Shrine''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, やさかじんじゃ) refers to [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrines]] named "Yasaka." It is sometimes written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}, which is covered in another article.
These shrines are dedicated to {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}}, the deity of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]]. Before the {{ill|Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|ja|神仏分離令|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神仏分離|1=shinbutsu bunri|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1970535}}, Susanoo-no-Mikoto was identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]].
Other names based on Gion faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|lt=Gion Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, {{ill|Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|広峯神社 (曖昧さ回避)|lt=Hiromine Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|lt=Tennō Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrines]], {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|lt=Yakumo Shrines|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrines]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|須佐神社|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|lt=Susa Shrine|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11664499}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine (disambiguation)]].
Notably, some exceptions include Yasaka shrines that enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]].
== Main Shrine == [[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Kyoto's [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]], one of the head shrines]] * '''[[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]]''' ({{ill|Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|ja|京都市東山区|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}) – Formerly {{ill|Kanjin'in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin'in Gion-sha|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} under [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai Buddhism]] and [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]] until the Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order. Claimed as the main shrine of Susanoo-no-Mikoto nationwide.
* ''' {{ill|Eki Shrine|ja|疫神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eki Shrine|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}}''' – Enshrines {{ill|Somin Shōrai|ja|蘇民将来命|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Somin Shōrai|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. '''Yasaka Shrine''' or '''Yasaka Jinja''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, Yasaka Jinja) refers to Shinto shrines that include "Yasaka" in their name. Some may also be written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}.
These shrines are part of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]], venerating {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}} (formerly identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]] before the [[:en:Shinbutsu bunri|Shinbutsu Bunri]] decree).
Other shrines based on Gion Faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, [[:en:Hiromine Shrine|Hiromine Shrine]], {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Tsushima Faith|ja|津島信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsushima Faith|qq=}}</ref>, {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrine]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine|ja|須佐神社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine|qq=}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Faith|ja|氷川信仰|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hikawa Faith|qq=}}</ref>, among others. Their usage varies by historical period and records.
However, there are exceptions where Yasaka Shrines enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]] instead.
The [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine (Kyoto)]] in Higashiyama, Kyoto, claims to be the head shrine of all shrines dedicated to Susanoo-no-Mikoto. Before the Shinbutsu Bunri decree, it was known as {{ill|Kanjin-in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin-in Gion-sha|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} of the [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai sect]], affiliated with [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]].

'''Yasaka Shrine''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, やさかじんじゃ) refers to [[:en:Shinto shrine|Shinto shrines]] named "Yasaka." It is sometimes written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}, which is covered in another article.
These shrines are dedicated to {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}}, the deity of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]]. Before the {{ill|Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|ja|神仏分離令|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神仏分離|1=shinbutsu bunri|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1970535}}, Susanoo-no-Mikoto was identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]].
Other names based on Gion faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|lt=Gion Shrines|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, {{ill|Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|広峯神社 (曖昧さ回避)|lt=Hiromine Shrines|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hiromine Shrine (disambiguation)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|lt=Tennō Shrines|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrines]], {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|lt=Yakumo Shrines|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrines]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|須佐神社|Susa Shrine (disambiguation)=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|lt=Susa Shrine|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Susa Shrine (disambiguation)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11664499}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine (disambiguation)]].
Notably, some exceptions include Yasaka shrines that enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]].
== Main Shrine == [[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Kyoto's [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]], one of the head shrines]] * '''[[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine]]''' ({{ill|Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|ja|京都市東山区|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}) – Formerly {{ill|Kanjin'in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin'in Gion-sha|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} under [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai Buddhism]] and [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]] until the Shinto-Buddhism Separation Order. Claimed as the main shrine of Susanoo-no-Mikoto nationwide.
* ''' {{ill|Eki Shrine|ja|疫神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eki Shrine|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}}''' – Enshrines {{ill|Somin Shōrai|ja|蘇民将来命|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Somin Shōrai|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. '''Yasaka Shrine''' or '''Yasaka Jinja''' (八坂神社・八阪神社, Yasaka Jinja) refers to Shinto shrines that include "Yasaka" in their name. Some may also be written as {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|ja|弥栄神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasaka Shrine|qq=}}.
These shrines are part of [[:en:Gion cult|Gion faith]], venerating {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素戔嗚尊|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to スサノオ}} (formerly identified with [[:en:Gozu Tennō|Gozu Tennō]] before the [[:en:Shinbutsu bunri|Shinbutsu Bunri]] decree).
Other shrines based on Gion Faith include {{ill|Gion Shrine|ja|祇園神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gion Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Gion shrine|WD=Q11588442}}, [[:en:Hiromine Shrine|Hiromine Shrine]], {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tennō Shrine|qq=}}, [[:en:Tsushima Shrine|Tsushima Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Tsushima Faith|ja|津島信仰|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsushima Faith|qq=}}</ref>, {{ill|Yakumo Shrine|ja|八雲神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yakumo Shrine|1=Yakumo shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11391847}}, [[:en:Yaegaki Shrine|Yaegaki Shrine]], {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suga Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susanoo Shrine|ja|素盞嗚神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo Shrine|qq=}}, {{ill|Susa Shrine|ja|須佐神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susa Shrine|qq=}}, and [[:en:Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|Hikawa Shrine]]<ref>{{ill|Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Shrine (Saitama)|lt=Hikawa Faith|ja|氷川信仰|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hikawa Faith|qq=}}</ref>, among others. Their usage varies by historical period and records.
However, there are exceptions where Yasaka Shrines enshrine [[:en:Yasakatome|Yasakatome-no-Kami]] instead.
The [[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine (Kyoto)]] in Higashiyama, Kyoto, claims to be the head shrine of all shrines dedicated to Susanoo-no-Mikoto. Before the Shinbutsu Bunri decree, it was known as {{ill|Kanjin-in Gion-sha|ja|感神院祇園社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjin-in Gion-sha|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 八坂神社|1=Yasaka Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q692714}} of the [[:en:Tiantai|Tendai sect]], affiliated with [[:en:Mount Hiei|Mount Hiei]].
[[File:Yasaka Jinja.jpg|thumb|250px|right|[[:en:Yasaka Shrine|Yasaka Shrine (Kyoto)]] (One of the Head Shrines)]]
